entities.summary: The Universidad a Distancia de Madrid (UDIMA), is a private online university based in Community of Madrid, Spain. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses using online digital tools. It is located in the Madrid town of Collado Villalba. Universidad a Distancia de Madrid is a private university in Europe, established in 2006-06-08. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
